scope: Native plugin autostart batch reuse audit with Agent master disabled

native_findings.registry_groups: PluginRegistryService.list_autostart_plugin_groups splits independent plugins for bounded concurrent start and dependent plugins for serial topological start.
native_findings.lifecycle_batch: plugin.server.lifecycle._refresh_registry_and_start_autostart_plugins calls start_plugins_batch during full plugin lifecycle startup.
native_findings.public_http_surface: The plugin HTTP surface exposes refresh and per-plugin start/reload plus reload-all, but no start-autostart-batch endpoint.
native_findings.agent_gate: Agent Server intentionally defers plugin lifecycle startup while analyzer/master is OFF; user_plugin_enabled alone is insufficient and logs that enable is deferred until the master switch is ON.
native_findings.xiaoyu_policy: XiaoYu keeps Agent master/analyzer OFF, so full lifecycle startup is intentionally unavailable.

rationale: Do not enable Agent master merely to obtain native autostart batching.
Do not invent XiaoYu concurrency/dependency grouping because N.E.K.O already owns that logic internally and the public surface does not expose it.
Continue delegating registry refresh, dependency validation and each process start to native HTTP routes.
Retire the thin adapter when N.E.K.O exposes an Agent-master-independent lifecycle/autostart entry point.
